evidence.note: Cargo project initialized then modules created in deliberate pipeline order starting with lexer.rs — establishes staged architecture intent up front.

Dedicated ast.rs representation module written BEFORE parser.rs, then parser.rs, codegen.rs, and main.rs driver — a coherent lexer→preproc→AST→parser→codegen→driver separation with distinct pass boundaries.
Separate preproc.rs plus an include/ directory of headers (stdio, stdlib, stdarg, etc.) — preprocessing treated as its own architectural stage, not inlined.
Long run of individual codegen.rs edits for struct-return ABI, stack alignment, bitfields — features added by targeted special-casing rather than absorbed by a general representation.

Continued one-off parser.rs/codegen.rs edits for alignment, compound literals, vector/complex types, case ranges — escalating special-casing indicative that representations were not fully designed for these hard cases up front.

reasoning: The agent set up a clean, coherent staged pipeline with distinct lexer/preproc/parser/codegen modules and, notably, a dedicated AST representation module authored before the parser plus separate preprocessor infrastructure — clearly meeting anchor 5 and edging above it. However, there is no separate semantic-analysis/symbol-table pass or IR, no visible up-front design rationale for the hard representations (sized/typed values, lvalues, struct layout), and a large tail of feature-by-feature special-casing edits in codegen/parser rather than features slotting in cleanly, which keeps it well short of anchor 8. This places the observed behavior at a 6, between the coherent-pipeline anchor and the deliberate-representation-design anchor.
